events.title: Steam Next Fest Is Here! Choose from 7 Languages in the Free Demo
events.summary: Hello from LDMV Works! Taking part in Steam Next Fest has been one of my goals, so it's a relief to have reached this point. How are you enjoying the demo? A request for another language inspired me to add more language options to the demo. You can now choose from seven languages: Japanese, English, Italian, German, French, Spanish and Simplified Chinese. Switch languages using the list on the title screen or in Settings. events.title: WHEN ARMIES WAVER — The free demo is now available
events.summary: Advance, hold the line, or fall back to regroup? Command an entire army, break enemy morale, and push back the battle line in this army-command roguelite. The free demo includes Stage 1: choose rewards, build your army, and follow a branching seven-area route to a boss battle. Available for Windows in English and Japanese. events.title: Development Update #1 — Preparing for Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Thank you for your interest in When Armies Waver. When Armies Waver is a medieval mass-battle roguelite about commanding an army through morale, formations, pressure along the battle line, and the decision to advance, hold, or withdraw. Command the Army, Not a Single Soldier You are the commander of the entire army. Do you push the battle line forward, hold your ground, or withdraw and recover?
